name: Numwit
tagline: A real-time multiplayer mind game — don't guess the number, guess everyone else.
description: Everyone secretly picks a number from 0 to 100 at the same time. The target is 80% of the average, and the closest pick wins the round while everyone else takes a penalty point. Five penalties and you're out — the last mind standing wins. Jump into a public room, start a private one with friends, or practise against bots. No signup, ever.
highlights: Real-time rounds for 3–8 players over WebSockets
Public rooms, private rooms with friends, or play vs bots
No account needed — pick a name and play

name: AI Gen Studio
tagline: An AI content studio that runs Instagram accounts end to end — from idea to posted reel.
description: A team of AI agents plans, writes, designs and publishes Instagram reels and carousels across multiple accounts. A strategist remembers what worked, a writer drafts each post, a compliance agent checks finance content against SEBI rules, and image and voice agents produce the visuals before editing assembles the final reel. Nothing goes out without a human review, and every rupee of AI spend is tracked against a monthly budget.
highlights: Multi-agent pipeline: strategy → writing → compliance → visuals → editing → review → posting
Runs several Instagram accounts with scheduling and live post status
Human-in-the-loop review before anything is published
SEBI compliance checks for finance content
Monthly AI spend tracking with a hard budget

name: BooknBeats
tagline: A music player that scores the book you are reading.
description: Tell it what you are reading and it recommends songs that match the book's theme and mood, powered by GPT-3.5.

name: Tax Calculator
tagline: Compare your income tax under the old and new Indian regimes.
description: Enter your taxable income and deductions and see the liability under both regimes side by side, so you can pick the cheaper one.
